title: Grateful Dead Live at L'Olympia on 1972-05-03
source: SBD > reel > DAT > CDR > EAC > shn

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy Paris show featuring a smoking Truckin’→Jam→Other One sequence and standout renditions of He's Gone, China Rider and Wharf Rat.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the marathon improvisational suite that weaves Truckin', a deep jam, multiple Other One reprises, Drums, Bobby McGee and Wharf Rat into a single, high‑octane experience. The soundboard recording is described as crisp and excellent, letting every nuance of Jerry’s wah‑wah‑laden guitar and the tight rhythm section shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic reviews praise both performance (standout jams, song execution) and recording quality (excellent soundboard), with no significant negatives.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear sound with no reported drop‑outs or muffiness; reviewers call it an "excellent sounding recording".

show_quality.setlist_flow: A remarkable, extended improvisational suite links Truckin' → Jam → Other One → Drums → Other One → Bobby McGee → Other One → Wharf Rat, creating a seamless high‑energy flow that fans describe as phenomenal.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jam showcases Jerry's wah‑wah tone reminiscent of the Ace era and his guitar work is highlighted throughout the extended sequence.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drums provide a solid, driving foundation for the long jam and multiple Other One reprises.
